verdict.rationale: BigQuery's loading docs describe a managed Pub/Sub BigQuery subscription that streams data in real time, "loading data as it's generated" at high throughput, so the user runs no pipeline of their own. The docs also describe near-real-time replication from databases and scheduled recurring transfers. The event-streaming core of the story is clearly delivered, but continuous ingestion of new files as they land is only evidenced as scheduled batch transfers at intervals. Missing for 10: event-driven file-arrival ingestion, detail on the Pub/Sub subscription and replication setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
